items.question: How does this help brokerages with 10–50 agents?
items.answer: Acme is built specifically to eliminate the manual coordination that slows growing teams. Instead of managers assigning leads one by one, the system routes leads instantly using predefined rules, freeing leadership to focus on coaching and growth rather than admin work.

items.question: What industries get the most value from Acme?
items.answer:
We focus on three core industries:

eCommerce & Retail: Returns management, inventory alerts, order tracking, payment reconciliation

Marketing Agencies & Teams: Lead capture and qualification, campaign execution, multi-channel distribution, CRM workflows

items.question: What types of business processes can you automate?

items.question: Can multiple AI agents work together in our organization?

Unlike solutions requiring separate platforms, our event-driven system enables seamless agent cooperation across your entire organization.

items.question: Can we customize the AI agents’ voices and personalities?

items.question: How accurate is the voice recognition capability?
items.answer: Our conversational voice AI employs advanced voice recognition technology that delivers high accuracy across different accents and speaking styles. Cognitive AI agents built on our platform understand natural speech patterns, industry-specific terminology, and handle background noise effectively while maintaining rapid response times for natural conversation flow.
